name: Sara Qureshi
summary: Application security engineer with five years reviewing business software. Recent assignments cover assistants that read company documents and request actions from internal services.

work_experience.title: Application Security Engineer
responsibilities_and_achievements: Tested whether instructions hidden in uploaded documents could redirect an assistant away from the user's request.
Verified that employees could not obtain another department's restricted records through generated answers.
Required action permissions to be checked by the receiving service rather than trusting text produced by a model.
Reviewed outbound requests for attempts to send confidential content to unapproved destinations.
Created repeatable abuse cases and checked fixes before the product was reopened to staff.

work_experience.title: Security Analyst
responsibilities_and_achievements: Reviewed service endpoints, investigated exposed credentials, and helped teams remove private data from diagnostic records.
Wrote Python utilities for repeatable permission checks.

projects.name: Document assistant abuse lab
projects.description: Constructed fake pages containing hostile instructions and verified that restricted files remained inaccessible. Produced remediation notes for the application team; did not own its passage-ranking implementation.
